key.name: placement
key.description: Where the controller appears: Quick Settings, the top bar, or both.

key.name: show-mode
key.summary: Show ANC mode on the top-bar button
key.description: Display the current ANC mode label next to the icon on the top-bar button.

key.name: show-battery
key.summary: Show battery percentage on the top-bar button
key.description: Display the battery percentage next to the icon on the top-bar button.

key.name: device-mac
key.description: MAC address of the device to control. Empty means auto-detect the first paired device whose name contains "ear".
